title: Flashcards: Official languages, Europe
intro: Flip each card about Europe. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: Which language is official in Andorra?
cards.explain: Catalan is the official language of Andorra.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Switzerland?
cards.explain: French, German, Italian are official languages of Switzerland.

cards.front: Which language is official in Denmark?
cards.explain: Danish is the official language of Denmark.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Finland?
cards.explain: Finnish, Swedish are official languages of Finland.

cards.front: Which language is official in France?
cards.explain: French is the official language of France.

cards.front: Which language is official in United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland?
cards.explain: English is the official language of United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

cards.front: Which language is official in Croatia?
cards.explain: Croatian is the official language of Croatia.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Ireland?
cards.explain: English, Irish are official languages of Ireland.

cards.front: Which language is official in Liechtenstein?
cards.explain: German is the official language of Liechtenstein.

cards.front: Which language is official in Lithuania?
cards.explain: Lithuanian is the official language of Lithuania.

cards.front: Which language is official in North Macedonia?
cards.explain: Macedonian is the official language of North Macedonia.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Malta?
cards.explain: English, Maltese are official languages of Malta.
